proposals: Funding proposals submitted by Global Health Engineering

Source: R/proposals.R
proposals.Rd

One row per funding proposal the group has submitted since 2020, with the status, the funder and the requested budget. The names of projects, leads, co-leads and partner organisations are not part of the data. Budgets in other currencies are converted to Swiss francs with the exchange rate of 1 July of the year of submission.

Usage

proposals

Format

A tibble with 16 variables

proposal_id

Identifier of the proposal, numbered in the order of submission. Carries no name of a project or a person.

project_id

Identifier of the project. Proposals with the same project_id are requests for the same project to different funders or in different years.

status

Status of the proposal. Levels: accepted, rejected, submitted (no answer yet), withdrawn.

submitted_date

Date the proposal was submitted. Where only the month is known, the first day of the month.

submitted_year

Year the proposal was submitted.

answer_date

Date of the answer of the funder. Where only the month is known, the first day of the month. NA when no answer was recorded.

days_to_answer

Days between submission and answer. NA when no answer was recorded or when the recorded answer lies before the submission.

funder

Funder or funding programme the proposal was submitted to, with one spelling per funder.

snsf

TRUE when the proposal went to a programme of the Swiss National Science Foundation.

budget

Requested budget in the currency of the proposal.

currency

Currency of the requested budget (ISO 4217 code).

rate_date

Date of the exchange rate used for budget_chf: 1 July of the year of submission, or the last banking day before it. NA for budgets in CHF.

budget_chf

Requested budget in Swiss francs, rounded to the franc. Converted with the reference rate of the European Central Bank on rate_date. NA when the budget or the currency is missing.

lead_data_steward

TRUE when the data steward of the group led the proposal. The only information on a lead in the data.

co_lead_external

TRUE when the proposal had a co-lead outside the group.

partner_organisation

TRUE when the proposal named a partner organisation.

Source

Table of submitted proposals kept by the group, read from Google Sheets with data-raw/data_processing_proposals.R. Exchange rates: reference rates of the European Central Bank, kept in data-raw/proposals_exchange_rates.csv.

Details

A project that was requested from several funders appears once per request, because each request is a proposal of its own. project_id shows which proposals belong to the same project.
